definitions.gloss: the same amount (of money); an equal sum
definitions.explanation: An amount of money equal to another one being discussed. Common in shopping, salaries, budgets and news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同額|どうがく}だ。
examples.english: It's the same amount as last year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{同額|どうがく}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: The two of us each paid the same amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昨年度|さくねんど}→昨年度：31687_sakunendo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧{同額|どうがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{百億円|ひゃくおくえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: This year's budget was set at ten billion yen, almost the same as last year's.

notes:
⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ (same) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount, sum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{同額|どうがく}: the same amount as ~
- {同額|どうがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧: a matching donation
- {同額|どうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay the same amount

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧: the full amount
- ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧: half price
- ⟦{差額|さがく}→差額：15775_sagaku⟧: the difference (between two amounts)
